parsed.rationale_overall: System A directly answers the user's query with an explicit year-by-year glide path table from age 55 to 65, providing the structured decade-long roadmap requested, plus complementary TIPS, dividend, and tax-location strategies aligned to the glide path. System B has stronger personalization and diversification awareness (addressing the 22% healthcare overweight) but fails to deliver the year-by-year glide path the user explicitly asked for, instead only covering Years 1-2 and including a less-relevant catch-up contribution rec.
